Author: Subhash Chandra Sharma

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Manoj Kumar Tripathi

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Chandra Sharma,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the material on record.

The present application u/s 483 Cr.P.C. has been moved with prayer to direct the learned court of Judicial Magistrate-I, Hapur to decide the Case No.146 of 2023 (State vs. Kushveer and others)
arising out of Case Crime No.326 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 323, 504 I.P.C. & Section 3/4 D.P.
Act, Police Station Babugarh, District Hapur, pending before him within specific period as fixed by this Hon'ble Court.

entities.text: Case No.146 of 2023 (State vs. Kushveer and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that a Case No.146 of 2023 is pending before the learned court of Judicial Magistrate-I, Hapur since 2023 and it is not being decided, therefore, prays Smt Nimisha Choudhary vs State Of U.P. on 15 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/157880700/
1 that a direction be issued to the learned court concerned to decide the same as expeditiously as possible.
Learned A.G.A. has no objection in this regard.

entities.text: Nimisha Choudhary vs State Of U.P. on 15 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon

sentences.text:
Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for the parties as well as perusal of record and the order sheet, this application is disposed of finally with direction to the learned court concerned to make its endeavour to decide the aforesaid case as expeditiously as possible, without granting any unnecessary adjournment to either of the parties, in accordance with law or if there is no legal impediment.
Order Date :- 15.3.2024
